sources.role: Pinned KiCad 9.0.5 parser uses footprint-relative pad coordinates and sets the pad orientation directly from its stored angle.
Pinned KiCad 9.0.5 RotatePoint maps a positive 90 degree angle to (y,-x); general formulas use x*cos+y*sin and y*cos-x*sin.
Current parser explicitly documents stored pad angles as board-frame absolute; omitted angles are axis aligned.
Primary grammar identifies pad size, optional rounding/chamfer ratios and selected corners.
Native chamfered-pad shape construction passes both corner radius and selected chamfer settings to its rounded/chamfered rectangle constructor.
KiCad initializes F&B.Cu as exactly F_Cu and B_Cu, distinct from the all-copper mask.

contract: Retain authored scalar values and source-shape/placement conventions without imitating KiCad integer-unit rounding. These are independently written regression expectations, not a whole-application KiCad differential run.
